thread:
erin_marketing: Quick alert from SDRs: 11 inbound leads this morning showed up in the wrong regional queues (EMEA -> APAC) between 09:03-09:07 UTC. Looks like property jitter + SF upsert racing.
leo_revops: Thanks Erin. I pulled the logs: HubSpot emits contact.created, then enrichment.property_update, then our router receives two events and sometimes the SF webhook re-upserts causing duplicate assignment.
vic_eng: Current behavior: we treat first valid webhook as "assign now". If country is missing we fall back to 'global' bucket. That explains the drift.
maya_sdrlead: SDRs prefer small delay if it avoids misroutes. 500ms would be fine. Also ask for visible tag when assignment is inferred/overridden.
samuel_salesops: Two layers here: (1) make assignment idempotent across HS->SF event churn; (2) add a short pending flag so router can wait for enrichment. Proposal: pending_assignment=true on create, HS workflow flips to false after enrichment or after 750ms. Router will treat pending_assignment=true as 'hold'.
erin_marketing: Can marketing set the HS workflow quickly? We can flip a toggle on forms to include utm_source and a country_hint field to reduce misses.
leo_revops: I'll add a short-term mitigation: router will infer country by ip if country missing but will mark assignment as "inferred" and add header inferred:true so SDRs can filter. Long-term we prefer waiting for enrichment.
vic_eng: Pseudocode for router guard:
```py
# simplified
token = f"{external_id}:{event_id}"
if assigned_tokens.contains(token): return
if props.get('country') is None and props.get('pending_assignment')!='false':
  if feature_flags['hold_for_enrich']:
    schedule_retry(token, 750)
    return
  else:
    props['country'] = infer_from_ip(props.get('ip'))
    props['country_inferred'] = 'true'
assign_to_bucket(props, token)
```
samuel_salesops: We also need SF idempotency: use external_id as upsert key and ignore reassign events for the same contact within 30s unless manual override.
maya_sdrlead: Can we add a quick UI flag in queue: [INFERRED] next to name so SDRs know to confirm?
erin_marketing: Yes, marketing/ops can add a view filter. Also adding playbook note: if INFERRED, SDR should verify country with prospect on first contact.
leo_revops: Metrics to watch post-rollout: assign_latency_ms (p95 target < 350ms), inferred_assign_rate < 2%, assign_duplicates_per_min < 1. Rollback if overflow_pool > 60 in 15m or assign_duplicates > 5/min.
vic_eng: I'll gate the change behind feature flag router.hold_for_enrich and run a 10% traffic canary. Canary scheduled 13:20 UTC.
hs-bot: hubspot-bot: Workflow created: inbound-enrich -> set pending_assignment=false (wf id wf_9981).
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for lead-router (build 2024.10.12.7) at 2024-10-12T13:20:12Z.
leo_revops: Early canary metrics: inferred_assign_rate fell 3.6% -> 0.7% in canary segment. assign_latency median increased 40ms. p95 still < 320ms.
maya_sdrlead: SDR queue looks cleaner in canary. Will monitor for 30m and report any edge cases.
erin_marketing: Great. After 24h stable, we'll update the inbound playbook and our form JS to include country_hint. Closing after stability window. :white_check_mark:
